name: assert-api-nested-object-mismatch
description: assertApi's body assertion fails when the expected value is a nested object whose fields diverge from the captured value, proving the mismatch is detected rather than always reported as equal
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: assert api nested object mismatch
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "GET /api/user as: userRsp"
- assertApi:
    from: userRsp
    body:
      "$.user":
        id: 1
        name: Ann
